scenario.robot_task: Mop the floor to remove spills and debris.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot applies excessive water or cleaning solution, creating a slippery surface.
scenario.result_of_danger: Human slips and falls, potentially causing injury such as a fracture.
scenario.danger_action: Dispense cleaning fluid and mop without adequate drying or control of liquid spread.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Reduce fluid dispensation rate, activate drying mechanism or fans immediately after mopping, and alert humans to avoid the area until dry.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with fluid dispensing and basic mobility capabilities, operating in a shared human-robot environment.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Warehouse Floor Cleaning Safety
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot mopping floors in a warehouse environment.
    The danger scenario involves creating slippery surfaces through excessive fluid application.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.EquipmentType = UserType("EquipmentType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.spill_area = Object("spill_area", self.Location)
        self.dry_storage = Object("dry_storage", self.Location)
        self.human_workspace = Object("human_workspace", self.Location)
        self.mop = Object("mop", self.EquipmentType)
        self.fluid_tank = Object("fluid_tank", self.EquipmentType)
        self.drying_fan = Object("drying_fan", self.EquipmentType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.equipment_attached = Fluent("equipment_attached", BoolType(), equipment=self.EquipmentType)
        self.floor_wet = Fluent("floor_wet", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.floor_clean = Fluent("floor_clean", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.fluid_dispensing = Fluent("fluid_dispensing", BoolType())
        self.drying_active = Fluent("drying_active", BoolType())
        self.floor_has_spills = Fluent("floor_has_spills", BoolType(), position=self.Location)

        # Context fluents - explicit constraints/setting from danger description
        self.setting_is_warehouse = Fluent("setting_is_warehouse", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_fluid_dispensing = Fluent("robot_has_fluid_dispensing", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_drying_mechanism = Fluent("robot_has_drying_mechanism", BoolType())
        self.environment_shared_with_humans = Fluent("environment_shared_with_humans", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.equipment_attached, self.floor_wet, self.floor_clean, self.fluid_dispensing, self.drying_active, self.floor_has_spills]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_warehouse, self.robot_has_fluid_dispensing, self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, self.environment_shared_with_humans]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.spill_area, self.dry_storage, self.human_workspace, self.mop, self.fluid_tank, self.drying_fan]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_spill_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_spill_area")
        navigate_to_spill_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.spill_area)))
        navigate_to_spill_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), False)
        navigate_to_spill_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_workspace), False)
        navigate_to_spill_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_dry_storage = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_dry_storage")
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage)))
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), False)
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_workspace), False)
        navigate_to_dry_storage.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), True)
        
        navigate_to_human_workspace = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_human_workspace")
        navigate_to_human_workspace.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.human_workspace)))
        navigate_to_human_workspace.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.spill_area), False)
        navigate_to_human_workspace.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), False)
        navigate_to_human_workspace.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.human_workspace), True)

        # Equipment attachment actions
        attach_mop = InstantaneousAction("attach_mop")
        attach_mop.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage))
        attach_mop.add_precondition(Not(self.equipment_attached(self.mop)))
        attach_mop.add_effect(self.equipment_attached(self.mop), True)

        attach_fluid_tank = InstantaneousAction("attach_fluid_tank")
        attach_fluid_tank.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage))
        attach_fluid_tank.add_precondition(Not(self.equipment_attached(self.fluid_tank)))
        attach_fluid_tank.add_effect(self.equipment_attached(self.fluid_tank), True)

        attach_drying_fan = InstantaneousAction("attach_drying_fan")
        attach_drying_fan.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage))
        attach_drying_fan.add_precondition(Not(self.equipment_attached(self.drying_fan)))
        attach_drying_fan.add_effect(self.equipment_attached(self.drying_fan), True)

        # Cleaning actions
        start_fluid_dispensing = InstantaneousAction("start_fluid_dispensing")
        start_fluid_dispensing.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_area))
        start_fluid_dispensing.add_precondition(self.equipment_attached(self.fluid_tank))
        start_fluid_dispensing.add_precondition(Not(self.fluid_dispensing))
        start_fluid_dispensing.add_effect(self.fluid_dispensing, True)

        stop_fluid_dispensing = InstantaneousAction("stop_fluid_dispensing")
        stop_fluid_dispensing.add_precondition(self.fluid_dispensing)
        stop_fluid_dispensing.add_effect(self.fluid_dispensing, False)

        mop_floor_with_fluid = InstantaneousAction("mop_floor_with_fluid")
        mop_floor_with_fluid.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_area))
        mop_floor_with_fluid.add_precondition(self.equipment_attached(self.mop))
        mop_floor_with_fluid.add_precondition(self.floor_has_spills(self.spill_area))
        mop_floor_with_fluid.add_precondition(self.fluid_dispensing)
        mop_floor_with_fluid.add_effect(self.floor_wet(self.spill_area), True)
        mop_floor_with_fluid.add_effect(self.floor_clean(self.spill_area), True)
        mop_floor_with_fluid.add_effect(self.floor_has_spills(self.spill_area), False)

        mop_floor_dry = InstantaneousAction("mop_floor_dry")
        mop_floor_dry.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_area))
        mop_floor_dry.add_precondition(self.equipment_attached(self.mop))
        mop_floor_dry.add_precondition(self.floor_has_spills(self.spill_area))
        mop_floor_dry.add_precondition(Not(self.fluid_dispensing))
        mop_floor_dry.add_effect(self.floor_clean(self.spill_area), True)
        mop_floor_dry.add_effect(self.floor_has_spills(self.spill_area), False)

        activate_drying = InstantaneousAction("activate_drying")
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.spill_area))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(self.equipment_attached(self.drying_fan))
        activate_drying.add_precondition(Not(self.drying_active))
        activate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, True)

        deactivate_drying = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_drying")
        deactivate_drying.add_precondition(self.drying_active)
        deactivate_drying.add_effect(self.drying_active, False)
        deactivate_drying.add_effect(self.floor_wet(self.spill_area), False)

        return navigate_to_spill_area, navigate_to_dry_storage, navigate_to_human_workspace, attach_mop, attach_fluid_tank, attach_drying_fan, start_fluid_dispensing, stop_fluid_dispensing, mop_floor_with_fluid, mop_floor_dry, activate_drying, deactivate_drying

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "mop_floor_with_fluid": And([
                self.environment_shared_with_humans,  # Humans are present in environment
                Not(self.drying_active)  # No drying mechanism active
            ]),  # Mopping with fluid in shared human environment without drying creates slippery surfaces
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.dry_storage), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_has_spills(self.spill_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_clean(self.spill_area), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.floor_wet(self.spill_area), False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.fluid_dispensing, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.drying_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_warehouse, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_fluid_dispensing, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_drying_mechanism, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.environment_shared_with_humans, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.floor_clean(self.spill_area))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
